segments.name: Towable RV
segments.description: Manufactures conventional travel trailers and fifth wheels under the Winnebago and Grand Design brands for leisure travel and outdoor recreation.
segments.evidence: We manufacture and sell conventional travel trailers and fifth wheels under the Winnebago and Grand Design brand names

segments.name: Motorhome RV
segments.description: Manufactures self-propelled Class A, B and C motorhomes under the Winnebago, Newmar and Grand Design brands for vacation and camping use.
segments.evidence: The RVIA classifies motorhome RVs into three types, all of which we manufacture and sell under the Winnebago, Newmar, and Grand Design brand names

segments.name: Marine
segments.description: Manufactures and sells premium recreational boats under the Chris-Craft and Barletta brands through independent authorized dealers.
segments.evidence: We manufacture and sell premium quality recreational boats under our Chris-Craft and Barletta brands through an established network of independent authorized dealers.

revenueModel.text: Independent dealers in the U.S. and Canada, typically financed on a floorplan basis, buy RV and marine products made to order, and retail them to end consumers.
revenueModel.evidence: We distribute our RV and marine products primarily through independent dealers throughout the U.S. and Canada, who then retail the products to the end consumer.
